column1: Automatic summarization has two common approaches: extraction and abstraction. Extraction selects important source sentences, while abstraction rewrites the content into a shorter form.
Large language models can summarize documents by identifying the main ideas, removing repeated details, and producing a concise answer for the reader.
A good summary should keep the key facts, avoid unnecessary examples, and stay faithful to the original document.
Customer support teams often summarize long conversations so another agent can quickly understand the problem, actions taken, and next step.
Research papers can be summarized by capturing the goal, method, main findings, and limitations in a few clear sentences.
